name: A Project's Records and Code as One Structure
vision_statement: A project's structure enables the continuous evolution of interdependent parts to optimize its intent.
opportunities: The structure can keep itself in any language (records beside the code, rules that prune themselves, a template refinement that reaches every record), so adopting ESOI costs a repository less each year it is used. This creative space goes beyond one repository's layout and is what the ideal Self-evolving structure names.
solution_coherence: Structure keeps a project's records and code one true and lean whole. The Intent Registry holds every problem, solution, implementation, ideal and metric as linked records beside the code they describe. It takes its fields from the author's template through Template Sync and fills the rows the code already declares through Specify from the Code, leaving a person's words untouched. The Ownership Map ties every file to the solution it serves, so code that serves nothing has nowhere to hide. Structure Check runs every rule on each change, reading the files the Ownership Map assigns and the fields Template Sync reads from the template, and reports each finding by rule and path with the next action. Structure Budget weighs what the rules that Structure Check runs cost each change against the real mistakes they catch, admits a new rule only with the mistake that justifies it, and prunes what stops paying.
